items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I get with Eddie Henderson, start working with him and Julian Priester. We worked six months in a club.

ctx.x: I mean, I already spent $60,000 of the guy’s money. Everything on the up and up. We worked. We worked gigs. We were trying to get ahead. A&M was behind it, sort

of. But to pull together something like that is a major deal. It doesn’t matter. I couldn’t pull it together. When it ended, I said, okay, I’ll stay in San Francisco, lick my wounds. I like living here. I was in between women, blah blah blah blah blah blah. It’s so nice out here. I’ll play jazz. So I got and I get with Eddie Henderson, start working with him and Julian Priester. We worked six months in a club. Nobody came. Nobody. It was called Christo’s, somewhere in San Francisco, Union Street or something.…
